name: Nazirite Vow (Nezirut)
notes: The laws of naziriteship: vow formulations, duration, prohibitions, and conclusion. Core topic of tractate Nazir.

name: Nazirite Prohibitions (Issurei Nazir)
notes: Three categories: wine and grape products, shaving, corpse impurity.

name: Nazirite Prohibition on Grape Products
notes: Prohibition on wine, grapes, chartzanim and zaggim (skins and seeds); combining quantities; olive-bulk threshold.

name: Nazirite Prohibition on Shaving (Taar HaNazir)
notes: Prohibition on cutting hair during naziriteship; what actions constitute a violation; shampooing vs. combing.

name: Nazirite Prohibition on Corpse Impurity
notes: Prohibition on contracting corpse impurity; which sources of impurity obligate shaving; met mitzvah exception.

name: Duration of Nazirite Term
notes: Default thirty-day term; extended terms; vow formulations affecting duration; multiple consecutive naziriteships.

name: Nazirite Like Samson (Nezirut Shimshon)
notes: Permanent naziriteship modeled after Samson; cannot lighten hair; no offering for impurity; distinction from ordinary permanent nazirite.

name: Permanent Nazirite (Nazir Olam)
notes: One who vows naziriteship forever; may lighten hair when it grows heavy; brings offerings like completing a term.

name: Nazirite Shaving of Purity (Giluach Taharah)
notes: Shaving and offerings at completion of pure nazirite term; procedure, order of offerings, throwing hair under the pot.

name: Nazirite Shaving of Impurity (Giluach Tumah)
notes: Shaving and offerings when nazirite becomes impure mid-term; sprinkling on third and seventh days; negating the tally.

name: Nazirite Offerings (Korbanot Nazir)
notes: Three offerings at end of naziriteship (sin, burnt, peace offering); bird offerings for impurity; wave offering of cooked foreleg.

name: Husband's Nullification of Wife's Naziriteship
hebrew: הפרת נזירות האשה על ידי הבעל
notes: When and how a husband can nullify his wife's nazirite vow; effect on separated offerings; limits of nullification after offerings begun.

name: Father's Naziriteship for Minor Son
notes: A father may impose naziriteship on his minor son; son may reject it; disposition of already-separated offerings.

name: Naziriteship Observed Outside Eretz Yisrael
notes: Dispute of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel whether one must repeat naziriteship upon arriving in Eretz Yisrael; case of Queen Helene.

name: Impurity Negating the Nazirite Tally
notes: Rules for when corpse impurity negates all or part of the days counted; disputes between Sages.

name: Conditional Nazirite Vow
notes: Vow contingent on birth of son, outcome of battle, etc.; what happens if condition is met mid-term.

name: Language and Substitutes for Nazirite Vow
notes: Valid substitute terms (nazik, nazi'ach, pazi'ach); intimations of nazirite vows; partial statements binding as naziriteship.

name: Erroneous Consecration (Hakdasha b'Ta'ut)
notes: Dispute of Beit Shammai and Beit Hillel whether erroneous consecration takes effect; cases of misidentified animals and objects.

name: Uncertain Impurity of Nazirite (Safek Tumah shel Nazir)
notes: Two nazirites where one may have become impure; procedures for offerings under uncertainty; case of the unknown impurity.

name: Impurity of the Depths (Tumat HaTehom)
notes: Unknown impurity from a corpse buried in the depths; does not negate a nazirite's tally; distinction from known impurity.

name: High Priest and Nazirite vs. Met Mitzvah
hebrew: כהן גדול ונזיר לעומת מת מצווה
notes: Dispute whether High Priest or nazirite must tend to met mitzvah when both are present; relative sanctity and offering obligations.

name: Nazirite Who Is Also a Leper
notes: Complex interaction when nazirite also has leprosy; shaving obligations of each conflict; procedure over 120-day period.

name: Naziriteship of Women, Slaves, and Gentiles
notes: Gentiles excluded from naziriteship; women and Canaanite slaves included; relative stringencies between women and slaves.

name: Samuel the Prophet as Nazirite
notes: Aggadic discussion on whether Samuel was a nazirite based on the word 'mora' in Hannah's prayer; comparison with Samson.

name: Taking Nazirite Vow While in a Cemetery
notes: Days spent in a cemetery at start of naziriteship do not count toward term; re-entry triggers impurity obligation.

name: Effect of Dissolving a Nazirite Vow
notes: What happens to separated offerings when a nazirite vow is dissolved by a halakhic authority; retroactive effect.

name: Chain of Nazirite Vows (And I — Va'Ani)
notes: When multiple persons vow naziriteship by saying 'and I' sequentially; dissolving one affects the others; interdependence of vows.

name: Vow to Fund Another Nazirite's Offerings
notes: One who accepts obligation to pay for another nazirite's shaving offerings; half vs. full obligation; mutual shaving arrangement.
